newsitem.title: UK: Guinness Flight to manage Granville Small Cos Fund.
newsitem.headline: Guinness Flight to manage Granville Small Cos Fund.

text.p: Guinness Flight Unit Trust Managers has taken over the management of the two million pound Granville Small Companies Unit Trust Plc, the fund manager said in a statement.

Guinness Flight expects smaller UK companies to outperform the wider market, especially in the building and contruction sector, said John McClure who heads Guiunness Flight's UK smaller companies trusts.
"Given the rationalisation of capacity that has taken place in the industry during the recession, improving volumes are likely to produce increases in margins," he said.
